title: Koncepciós perek és kirakatperek (Show Trials: Mindszenty and Rajk)
grammar: Authoritarian Mechanics, Totalitarian Discourse & State Terror Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what a show trial was and who Rajk and Mindszenty were.
I can say what happened to Rajk and to Mindszenty.
I can say what rehabilitation meant for the victims.
I can use six words about the show trials, such as koncepciós per and ellenségkép.
